title: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2609.13406v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When we speak of recursive self-improvement (RSI), are we speaking of a phenomenon, a mechanism, or a prospect? Towards autonomous and evolving intelligence, RSI is being claimed at many scales, while no single framework that formally describes these emerging instances exists. Its counterpart in the classical realm, iterative policy improvement, is characterized by generalized policy iteration (GPI), a framework of broad applicability with well-understood theoretical properties, but only where the update principle and the evaluation base lie outside the agent. In this paper, we propose Generalized Agent Iteration (GAI), a formal framework that describes iterative policy improvement and RSI as two cases of a single learning paradigm. GAI defines the agent as a configuration of modifiable components within a system and models the learning process as a cycle of agent evaluation and agent improvement. translated_title: 广义智能体迭代：迭代策略改进与递归自我改进的统一形式化框架
translated_abstract: 当我们谈论递归自我改进（RSI）时，我们谈论的是一种现象、一种机制，还是一种前景？在迈向自主且不断演进的智能的道路上，RSI在多个尺度上被宣称，然而目前尚不存在一个能够正式描述这些新兴实例的统一框架。它在经典领域的对应物——迭代策略改进——由广义策略迭代（GPI）所刻画，这是一个适用范围广泛且理论性质被充分理解的框架，但它仅适用于更新原则和评估基础位于智能体之外的情形。在本文中，我们提出广义智能体迭代（GAI），一个将迭代策略改进与递归自我改进描述为同一学习范式两种情形的形式化框架。GAI将智能体定义为系统内可修改组件的一种配置，并将学习过程建模为智能体评估与智能体改进的循环。两个关键的可调节维度进而区分了……
tldr: 本文提出广义智能体迭代（GAI）形式化框架，将经典迭代策略改进与递归自我改进统一为同一学习范式下的两种情形，通过“评估-改进”循环建模智能体的学习过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Generalized Agent Iteration (GAI), a formal framework that unifies classical iterative policy improvement and recursive self-improvement as two cases of a single learning paradigm, modeling learning as a cycle of agent evaluation and agent improvement.
